# La Redonda Indoor Soccer

> Aventura's only indoor turf field. A climate-controlled indoor soccer field at 2695 NE 188th St, Aventura, FL 33180, open 7 days a week, for field rentals, leagues, tournaments, birthday parties, camps, kids' programs and private training. English and Spanish spoken.

Last updated: 2026-11-12. Website: https://laredondaindoorsoccer.com/ (Spanish / Español: https://laredondaindoorsoccer.com/es/)

## Contact
- Reservations, parties and events: (786) 969-0588. You can call, text or WhatsApp. Email: gonzame@laredondaindoorsoccer.com
- Address: 2695 NE 188th St, Aventura, FL 33180, next door to Drew Jordan Basketball (2685 NE 188th St)
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=La+Redonda+Indoor+Soccer&destination_place_id=ChIJ02Qx3Fas2YgRNax7LPJd03Q
- Google reviews: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=La+Redonda+Indoor+Soccer&query_place_id=ChIJ02Qx3Fas2YgRNax7LPJd03Q
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/laredondaindoorsoccer/
- Opening hours: not published yet. Call (786) 969-0588.

## The field
- Indoors and climate-controlled, so heat, rain and lightning don't stop play
- FIFA two-star artificial turf and stadium-style lighting
- Restrooms and water fountains on site

## What La Redonda offers
- **Field rental:** the whole field by the hour for 4v4 and 5v5 games, teams, friends and companies. From $130 per hour. Call to confirm availability and current pricing. Daytime, evening and late-night slots by reservation.
- **Leagues and tournaments:** organized competition. Call for details.
- **Birthday parties:** soccer parties on the field. Call (786) 969-0588 to plan one.
- **Seasonal camps:** dates vary and space is limited. Call for upcoming dates.
- **La Redonda FC After-School Soccer:** ages 2–6. Coach Gonzalo, (786) 969-0588.
- **Private soccer instruction:** Coach Sebastien, call or text (786) 489-3702. Individual, small-group and futsal sessions, ages 3 and up, all skill levels.
- **i9 Sports® youth programs at La Redonda:** Soccer, Flag Football and Multi-Sport, run by i9 Sports Northeast Dade. Seasons, times and fees: https://www.i9sports.com/venues/33180-la-redonda-indoor-turf-field-aventura-youth-sports-programs/12086. Questions: Coach Mike, 305-239-0731.

## Free membership
- Join for free at https://laredondaindoorsoccer.com/#join. Members get $10 off their first registration for La Redonda or i9 Sports programs at La Redonda, plus season updates, free clinics and members-only events like tournament teams and special guest coaches.

## Current notices (update or remove when they expire)
- i9 Sports winter season at La Redonda: Saturdays, 6 weeks, starting Saturday, December 5, 2026. Includes Multi-Sport, Tot Soccer, Pee-Wee Soccer and Pee-Wee Flag Football. Saturdays: Multi-Sport (ages 3–6) 9–10 AM, Tot Soccer (age 3) 10–11 AM, Pee-Wee Soccer (ages 4–6) 11 AM–12 PM, Pee-Wee Flag Football (ages 4–6) 12–1 PM. All four meet Dec 5 and 12, then Jan 9, 16, 23 and 30. There are no sessions Dec 19, Dec 26 or Jan 2. Register: https://www.i9sports.com/venues/33180-la-redonda-indoor-turf-field-aventura-youth-sports-programs/12086
- Indoor soccer clinic with Coach Sebastien: Saturdays, November 21 and 28, 2026, 10–11 AM. Individual and team skills, passing, shooting and teamwork. First come, first served, up to 20 players, no registration. $30 for the day, paid on site with cash or Zelle; free for La Redonda members (membership is free at https://laredondaindoorsoccer.com/#join). Questions: text (786) 489-3702.

## Frequently asked questions
- Where is it? 2695 NE 188th St, Aventura, FL 33180.
- How do I book? Call or WhatsApp (786) 969-0588, or email gonzame@laredondaindoorsoccer.com.
- Is it air-conditioned? Yes.
- Is it open every day? Yes, 7 days a week. Call for available times.
- How much is a field rental? From $130 per hour. Call to confirm.
- How do I become a member? Join free at https://laredondaindoorsoccer.com/#join for $10 off a first registration.
- Kids' ages? La Redonda FC is for ages 2–6. Private training is for ages 3 and up. For i9 Sports ages, see i9sports.com.

## En español
La Redonda Indoor Soccer es la única cancha de césped bajo techo en Aventura, con aire acondicionado. Ofrecemos alquiler de la cancha (desde $130 por hora, llama para confirmar), ligas, torneos, fiestas de cumpleaños, campamentos, fútbol después de clases para edades de 2 a 6 años, clases privadas con el Coach Sebastien ((786) 489-3702) y programas juveniles de i9 Sports. Reservaciones por llamada, texto o WhatsApp al (786) 969-0588. Dirección: 2695 NE 188th St, Aventura, FL 33180.
